newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Western Digital rises.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Western Digital rises.

text.p: Western Digital Corp rose to 71 from a close of 68-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange during after-hours trading on Monday, traders said.
"All eyes are on Western Digital," one of them said.
The company reported earlier in the day second-quarter earnings of $1.35 per share against $0.75 for the same period last year.
Other stocks were also moving higher during the session amid late-breaking corporate news.
Conrail Inc was trading a little higher at 102-1/2 from a close of 101-1/2.
Norfolk Southern Corp said Monday it was prepared to buy 9.9 percent of the company's shares at $115 each if the company's shareholders defeated an opt-out measure.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc edged up to 29-5/8 after a close of 29-3/8, Sanmina Corp went higher to reach 58-1/4 against a close of 57-5/8, while Conseco Inc was at 68-1/2 compared with 66-7/8.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 311,500 shares against Friday's 109,000 and session two had 1,610,877. There was no session two at the end of last week.
